title: Is Forgetting Unified? Exploring Concept Unlearning in Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Unified multimodal models can generate images and understand visual content, but forgetting a concept in one pathway does not necessarily remove it from the other. We introduce UUBench to evaluate cross-pathway concept unlearning and propose UniForget to jointly suppress target concepts while preserving other model capabilities.
